name: Kuma
description: Ruzi's wolf, who smells the blood, kills the ogre, and guards the baby Zi.

description_citations.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
description_citations.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi and his wolf Kuma cross the high beam without hesitation to teach his students to trust their wolves.
timeline.quote: But Ruzi urged his wolf forward without hesitation.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi recalls Cecilee's departure for the Rubblebelt and her silence, and that she adopted a Gruul child named for him.
timeline.quote: He'd heard that she'd adopted an abandoned Gruul child to raise as her own.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi and Kuma reach the edge of the Rubblebelt before dawn and must leave the rooftops to find Cecilee's community.
timeline.quote: Hours later, Ruzi and Kuma had reached the last roof at the edge of the Rubblebelt.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

timeline.summary: Kuma smells blood and carries Ruzi through the shattered gate into the settlement, surprising Massacre Girl and her men.
timeline.quote: The two surprised Massacre Girl and her men as they searched the bodies for anything valuable.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi and Kuma dodge the ogre's chains and Kuma kills him by the throat.
timeline.quote: but the wolf's teeth closed around its throat before the ogre could raise its meaty arms to defend itself.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi buries the dead in a mass grave, including his sister, without looking at her.
timeline.quote: he couldn't bear to look at his sister—not even as he placed her body into the mass grave

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi finds baby Zi alive in a hidden cradle and reasons the Rakdos were hired by someone from the city proper.
timeline.quote: Whoever hired Massacre Girl was someone from the city proper, someone who had coin to waste on murder.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

timeline.summary: Ruzi rejoins Kuma, who guards the baby Zi, and vows to tear down the city.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.

relations.quote: the three of them—Cecilee, Ruzi, and his wolf Kuma—had been inseparable.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 1" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Sep 2012.

relations.quote: Only then did Kuma insist that Ruzi take a moment to grieve.

citation.work: In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3
citation.text: "In Praise of the Worldsoul, Part 3" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Oct 2012.
